decision.scopeOfAccept: ACCEPT of component-manifest-leftover-join.v4 as a DESIGN-CONTRACT-CANDIDATE at 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no express reservation. The artifact remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, and carries DO-NOT-SEAL on its own terms. DR-103 is not SATISFIED and is not D-056-eligible; all five protected obligations remain leftoverDesign true; no fixture bytes, device-name list, envelope, OD-1 number, or schema successor is authored; no DR-G* row is added; required-now remains 26.
decision.summaryForCoordinator: The strongest available attack on this successor is that it splits an obligation, and splitting is the standard way to shrink a leftover set while appearing to add rigour. It fails on the arithmetic. v4 adds OBL-WINDOWS-PATH-NAMED at leftoverDesign false but subtracts nothing: summary.leftoverDesign is == v3's, the same five ids, which are also == the dispatch's protected list, and OBL-WINDOWS-PATH keeps leftoverDesign true with only its reason text expanded. Ten of eleven inherited obligations are byte-identical to v3, the eleventh differs in prose alone, and v4 adds three custody keys v3 lacked while removing none. The naming measurement is earned: the catalog exists at its pinned digest, carries a Claude ACCEPT with zero findings, and names all three live members verbatim — I compared the list by == against live v6 in all three places it is carried, and it is equal everywhere with no fourth member anywhere in the chain. The 51-fixture audit reproduces exactly once the right denominator is used: a naive walk of v6 yields 90 path/digest pairs, but the authored set is v6 /authored at length 51, and all 51 are present with zero mismatches. Two prohibitions needed the decisive test rather than a token count. For the device-name list, 'reserved device names' is the live v6 member name and appears three times as such — the real test is whether vocabulary is minted, and a regex for CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0-9 and LPT0-9 returns zero matches. For the envelope, the standalone word occurs zero times; every ENVELOPE hit is the live member name ENVELOPE_MISMATCH. No OD-1 number exists either: the complete bare-integer set is 0, 2, 3, 4, 08, 26 and 51, all accounted for. On the landed finding I read the originating charge on platform-tcb-leftover-join.v3 rather than assuming it, and tested both limbs. The identity chain measures v1/1, v2/2, v3/3, v4/4, so this family never had the version collision the finding names — and the subject does not pretend it did, scoping its authorityClaim to landing the finding 'on predecessor role sentences' where the sdk sibling's wording would have been false here. The stale sentence is replaced with the version-agnostic 'Not this artifact's version number' rather than re-pointed at a new pair, and the one permitted self-referential sentence is present and true. All 21 cited path/digest pairs measure equal with zero mismatches, recordedInputs.HEAD equals the top-level head and live HEAD, required-now is 26 across thirty gate rows, the liveGateOwner string is an exact match to file 08's DR-G15 owner column, and both the subject and the frozen v3 did not move. Twenty-three attacks run, twenty-three refuted, zero findings. Two things a coordinator should know without them being defects: two live register cells are now factually behind the corpus — DR-G15 still says the harness is 'not authored' and DR-103 still recites 'no fixtures exist to run' against 51 that reproduce — and the subject names both as stale, routes them to a later MF-6, and pointedly does not use them to argue D-013's refusal is spent. Disclosure: all three cited claude2 reviews are my own; every digest was recomputed from disk and every claim re-derived from the live source rather than from my earlier reviews.
